name: com.defacegames.gridlevel
description: Editor tool for building levels by placing 3D prefabs on an XZ, XY or YZ grid, or freely off the grid. Includes a prefab palette, ghost preview, paint/rectangle/line/fill tools, stacking, multi-cell footprints, rotation and scale tools, random variants, selection with rotate, scale and delete, and save/load to assets or JSON.

samples.description: A small demo room built with the tool (stacking, 2x1 and 2x2 pieces, rotations, crate variants), its palette and saved Level Data, plus the simple test prefabs it uses.
